welcome.text: Welcome to Hydris Field Glasses. In the next few minutes, I will show you how a treatment plant operator works with live data, guided rounds and a voice assistant, right in their line of sight.

problem-paper.text: Today, most field work still runs on clipboards and paper logbooks. Readings are copied into the system hours later, which brings delays and transcription errors.

problem-field.text: Gloves are wet, phones stay in pockets, and alarms often reach the wrong person, late. Operators walk their rounds without seeing any live plant data.

problem-evidence.text: And when the auditor visits, the compliance evidence sits in paper folders that nobody can search.

solution.text: Hydris brings live readings, alarms, rounds, approved SOPs and audit records to the operator, hands free, and turns every action into a verified digital record. Hydris only advises. It never controls equipment.

status-bar.text: This is the status bar. It shows your site, the connection, the live data stream and anything still waiting to sync.

home.text: Home is your shift at a glance. Your next inspection sits on top, followed by everything you need for this shift.

readings.text: Live measurements stream in from the plant. Every value shows how fresh it is, so you never act on an old reading.

alarms.text: Alarms reach you the moment they trigger, sorted by severity. Tap the alarm to open it.

alarm-detail.text: You see the value at trigger, the asset and the next step from the approved procedure. Acknowledge tells the control room you are on it. It does not change any equipment.

rounds.text: Your inspection rounds are assigned from the console. Open one, and Hydris walks you through it, step by step.

rounds-offline.text: Verify the equipment, confirm safety, then record each reading. No signal near the clarifier? Every step is saved on the device and syncs on its own when you are back online.

sops.text: The SOP library holds only approved procedures, so the operator always follows the current version.

scan.text: Audit scan turns a paper sheet into a verified record. Guided capture frames the page, OCR reads it, and two people approve it before it is saved as a Word or PDF soft copy.

voice.text: Just say Hey Hydris, and ask. Answers come from your plant data and approved procedures, so your hands stay on the job.

menu.text: Use Back to step out of any screen, and Home to return to your shift. On the glasses, the temple touchpad does the same.

device.text: Device and log out shows this device and its session. Sign out or unpair from here when your shift ends.

console-sees.text: Back in the control room, the console sees what you see. Supervisors watch the live glasses view, assign work and approve records in real time.

closing.text: That is Hydris Field Glasses. Safer rounds, faster response and audit ready records, straight from the field. Thank you for watching.
